Name: Motorcycle Mod - Continued
Author: CyanFire
Description:
This is a continuation of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/92543543]akane2010[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10553]Motorcycle Mod[/url].


Allows the player to ride around on a motorcycle. Does not replace the horse or tractor (if Tractor Mod is installed).

Has it's own sounds included.

Motorcycle & garage textures can be changed in the same way as [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/tree/stable/TractorMod#custom-textures]Tractor Mod[/url], except the texture locations are as follows:

Mods/Akane.MotorcycleMod/Garage
Mods/Akane.MotorcycleMod/Motorcycle
Mods/Akane.MotorcycleMod/BuffIcon


In multiplayer mode:
[list]
[*]It must be installed by the main player, and any farmhands that want to use the motorcycle features. Farmhands who don't have it installed won't have any issues, they just won't see the motorcycle textures or be able to use its features.
[/list]

Mod Conflicts:

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7911]Horse Overhaul[/url]﻿ - Currently motorcycle's can be petted, fed & have saddlebags, compatibility will need to be added by that mod's author.


Based off of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1552317]Pathoschild[/url]'s code for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401]Tractor Mod[/url]

Downloads.Description: The motorcycle's texture override is now visible to other mods via the new motorcycle.Sprite.overrideTextureName field.

Manifest.Name: Motorcycle Mod
Manifest.Description: Lets you buy a motorcycle to get around the town faster
Manifest.Author: Akane & CyanFire
